title: The Lotus and the Blood Moon
premise:
Three hundred years ago the Blood Moon Patriarch, Xue Wuji, drowned three kingdoms in blood trying to seize the heavens. The Azure Cloud Sect and the Verdant Lotus Sect sealed him beneath the Blood Moon Abyss with the Azure Heaven Seal, whose two keys are the Azure Eye, the sect's great formation array, and the Lotus Key. Every Verdant Lotus elder gave their life to forge it, and the world forgot their name.

Now an orphan climbs the nine thousand steps to the Azure Cloud with nothing but a mother's jade pendant. The seal is weakening, red-eyed beasts prowl the mountain, and someone inside the sect is helping the Blood Moon. The pendant is the Lotus Key, and its bearer is the last of a forgotten bloodline.

chapters.title: The Outer Disciple
chapters.summary: An orphan with a jade pendant climbs nine thousand steps to the Azure Cloud Sect. Sect rules, sore muscles, a proud rival and a first taste of qi, until red-eyed wolves prowl the sect wall for the first time in three hundred years.

chapters.title: Whispers in the Bamboo
chapters.summary: A routine herb mission into the Whispering Bamboo Forest turns into a hunt for corrupted wolves, a meeting with a hermit and a masked wanderer, and a bandit camp caging mortals. In its chest lies a blood-red jade token that should not exist.

chapters.title: Shadows over Qingshi
chapters.summary: Mortals vanish from Qingshi Town every new moon. With Senior Sister Han Xue, you follow a trail of gossip, blood lotus and graveyard runes to a kindly temple keeper who is neither kindly nor a keeper.

chapters.title: Ruins of the Forgotten Sect
chapters.summary: The library's Blood Moon records are missing. The Bamboo Hermit reveals who he really is and what your pendant really is. In the ruins of the Verdant Lotus Sect, a stone guardian waits for its heir, and you establish your foundation.

chapters.title: The Inner Sect Tournament
chapters.summary: Banners rise over the Azure Cloud for the Inner Sect Tournament. Rivals become partners, a poisoned pill box points at the Law Hall, and on the night of the final the traitor finally shows his face.

chapters.title: Descent into the Blood Moon
chapters.summary: Guided by the masked wanderer, who was once one of them, you descend into the Blood Moon Abyss. Obelisks drink the blood of caged cultivators, Han Xue is taken, and at the Altar of Blood the traitor feeds the seal to its prisoner.

chapters.title: Siege of Qingshi
chapters.summary: The Blood Moon and Iron-Fang's bandits march on Qingshi. With Zhao Kang and Wei Tong at your side, you turn a frightened market town into a fortress, and learn that the siege was never really about the town.

chapters.title: Isles Above the Clouds
chapters.summary: The Celestial Sky Isles open once every sixty years. With Han Xue and Zhao Kang you gather star iron, thunder crystals and phoenix feathers for the Great Azure Formation, face the corrupted Jiao serpent, and hear a star-gazer doubt the sect's design.

chapters.title: The Heart Demon
chapters.summary: On the eve of lighting the Great Azure Formation, a letter from the traitor lures you to the Heart Mirror, where you must defeat your own shadow. You return to a burning sky, and Elder Mo pays the price for the sect's trust. Now you know what the Patriarch truly wants: you.

chapters.title: Heavenly Tribulation
chapters.summary: Under the last blood moon the Azure Cloud marches into the Abyss. A traitor opens the black gate at the cost of his life, the Blood Moon Patriarch falls on his throne, and his remnant flees to the Sky Isles to steal your heavenly tribulation. At the summit, with lightning in your veins, you face your shadow one last time, and climb.

master_yun.name: Yun Qingyao
master_yun.title: Sect Master of the Azure Cloud
barks: The clouds are restless today. So am I.
Cultivate diligently, disciple. Heaven favours the stubborn.
Every stone of this mountain was laid by someone braver than me.

elder_mo.name: Mo Changfeng
elder_mo.title: Outer Court Elder
barks: Back straight! A crooked spine makes a crooked meridian.
Hmph. You're late. The mountain doesn't wait, and neither do I.
When I was your age I climbed these steps on my hands. Both ways.
Tea? No. Training. Tea is for people who have finished training.

elder_bai.name: Bai Qiu
elder_bai.title: Keeper of the Scripture Pagoda
barks: Shh. The books are sleeping.
Seven floors, ten thousand scrolls, and nobody returns anything on time.
If you fold a page corner, I will fold you.

elder_gu.name: Gu Hanshan
elder_gu.title: Elder of the Law Hall
barks: The precepts are not suggestions, disciple.
The Law Hall sees everything. Remember that.
Move along. I am thinking.

elder_hua.name: Hua Lian
elder_hua.title: Elder of the Medicine Hall
barks: Mind the moonbell sprouts. They bite.
A pill is only as honest as the hand that refines it.
You look pale. Eat something green. No, not that.

senior_han.name: Han Xue
senior_han.title: Inner Disciple, Frost Sword Peak
barks: Your stance is sloppy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.
I don't do small talk. Medium talk, perhaps.
Breathe in for four, hold for four. You'll thank me later.

senior_wei.name: Wei Tong
senior_wei.title: Senior Outer Disciple
barks: Training's done when the dummies cry. They never cry. So we never stop.
Have you eaten? You should eat. I should eat.
My sword is called Dumpling. Don't laugh. It knows.

rival_zhao.name: Zhao Kang
rival_zhao.title: Outer Disciple of the Zhao Clan
barks: The plum blossoms bloom for those worthy of them.
Hmph. Still here?
One day my name will be carved on the Sect Stele. Yours can go underneath.

gate_lu.name: Lu Ping
gate_lu.title: Gate Disciple
barks: Halt! Who goes... oh, it's you. Carry on.
I wasn't sleeping. I was meditating with my eyes closed. And snoring.
Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Slow day.

steward_qian.name: Qian Duo
steward_qian.title: Treasury Steward
barks: Every spirit stone has a name. Mostly mine.
Requisitions go in triplicate. Quadruplicate if you smile.
Do not touch the cauldron. The incense costs more than you do.

xiao_man.name: Xiao Man
xiao_man.title: Medicine Hall Apprentice
barks: The carp know my name! Well, they know my crumbs.
Elder Hua says I have a gift. For dropping things.
Do you think lotus flowers get lonely at night?

xiao_shi.name: Xiao Shi
xiao_shi.title: Outer Disciple, rescued from the Abyss
barks: I still count the bars of a cage when I close my eyes. Then I open them.
My sister won't stop feeding me. I'm not complaining.
Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

hermit_lan.name: The Bamboo Hermit
hermit_lan.title: Recluse of the Whispering Forest
barks: The bamboo bends, and so it survives three hundred winters.
Tea is steeping. It has been steeping for a decade. Patience.
Tread softly. The forest remembers footsteps.

wanderer_ye.name: Ye Wuming
wanderer_ye.title: Masked Wanderer
barks: Names are chains. I lost mine on purpose.
Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

bandit_tie.name: Tie Hu, Iron-Fang
bandit_tie.title: Bandit Chief
barks: What are you looking at?
Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

magistrate_zhou.name: Magistrate Zhou Wen
magistrate_zhou.title: Magistrate of Qingshi
barks: The yamen is open to all petitions. Between the second and fourth bell.
Order! Order! Oh, it's quiet. Carry on.
An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I sleep very poorly.

innkeeper_fang.name: Madam Fang
innkeeper_fang.title: Proprietor of the Drunken Crane Inn
barks: Wine, noodles or gossip? The gossip is free, the rest is not.
Immortals drink like fish and pay like cats.
Wipe your boots! This floor has seen emperors. Well, a tax collector.

constable_du.name: Du Ming
constable_du.title: Constable of Qingshi
barks: Gate closes at dusk. Always has. Always will.
Trouble? Tell me. I'll write it down. Then I'll deal with it.
Keep your sword sheathed in town, cultivator.

widow_liu.name: Widow Liu
widow_liu.title: Townswoman
barks: The water's sweet this season. Take a cup.
Every face that passes, I look twice.
Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine.

keeper_hong.name: Keeper Hong
keeper_hong.title: Keeper of the Town Temple
barks: May the ancestors watch over you.
Incense for the lost? Half a copper. The ancestors accept discounts.
Such a strong young cultivator. Such vigorous blood.

ferryman_pan.name: Old Pan
ferryman_pan.title: Ferryman of the Qing River
barks: River's high. Fares are higher.
Forty years on this water. It never lies to me.
Mind the third plank. It has opinions.

merchant_jin.name: Jin Baoshan
merchant_jin.title: Master of the Merchant Guild
barks: Everything has a price. Friendship especially.
Crates, crates, crates. Mind the stamp, it's imported.
Business is business, immortal. Nothing personal.

patriarch_xue.name: Xue Wuji
patriarch_xue.title: Patriarch of the Blood Moon
barks: Kneel.
Three hundred years is a long time to be hungry.

crimson_xuemei.name: Xue Mei
crimson_xuemei.title: Crimson Elder of the Blood Moon
barks: How delicious you look.
Run, little lamb. I do love a chase.

heart_demon.name: Heart Demon
heart_demon.title: Your Own Shadow
barks: Look closer. It's you.

star_sage.name: Qing Luan
star_sage.title: Star-Gazing Sage of the Sky Isles
barks: The stars do not lie. They merely exaggerate.
Sixty years since the isles last opened. You took your time.
Sit. Look up. Try not to fall off.

quests.title: The Mountain Gate
quests.summary: You have climbed nine thousand steps to reach the Azure Cloud Sect. Present yourself at the gate and to the Outer Court Elder.

objectives.text: Watch the mountain gate open
Speak with the gate disciple

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Halt! State your name and business. And please don't faint, the last three candidates fainted on my boots.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I am {player}. I have a letter of recommendation from the village of Willow Creek.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A letter! Very fancy. Mostly they bring mud and hope. Go on through, Elder Mo is at the hall steps.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Tip from your future Senior Brother: bow low, speak little, and never, ever mention his beard.

objectives.text: Climb to the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The main hall rises above a sea of white stone, its double eaves curling like a crane about to fly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nine thousand steps. My legs are crying. But I'm here.

objectives.text: Present yourself to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Another one. Let me guess. Orphan, no family, dreams of flying on a sword.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Orphan, yes. The sword can wait. I want to become strong enough to protect people.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Better answer than most. What is that jade at your belt?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My mother's pendant. It's all I have of her.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Keep it close, then. Welcome to the Azure Cloud, {junior}. Tomorrow you learn how little you know.

quests.title: Rules of the Azure Cloud
quests.summary: Every outer disciple must learn the Nine Precepts of the sect and draw the monthly allowance from the Treasury Steward.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Gu of the Law Hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You are the new one. I am Gu Hanshan of the Law Hall. I enforce the precepts. All of them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Nine Precepts are carved on the stele inside the gate. Learn them. Ignorance is not a defence.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: And that pendant. Jade draws envy, and envy draws blood. Keep it hidden, disciple.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes, Elder. I will be careful.

objectives.text: Read the Nine Precepts

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Do not harm a fellow disciple. Do not steal the sect's treasures. Do not consort with demonic cultivators.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last precept is worn smooth by generations of fingers. It reads: guard the seal, even unto death.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Guard the seal? What seal?

objectives.text: Bow before the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense smoke curls past the hall doors. Inside, the founder's tablet gleams, and beside it a lotus, carved in faded green.

objectives.text: Collect your allowance from Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Allowance, allowance. Everyone wants their allowance. Name? Ah, the new one. Three spirit stones.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Minus one for your robe. Minus one for the robe's laundering. That leaves... hmm, one. Congratulations.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The robe was already dirty.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Then it was a very efficient laundering. Next!

quests.title: Iron Body, Iron Will
quests.summary: Senior Brother Wei Tong runs the outer disciples' combat drills. Show him you can swing a sword without losing it.

objectives.text: Find Senior Brother Wei at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ah, fresh meat! No offence. I call everyone fresh meat. I'm usually hungry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, senior outer disciple. I teach the basics: stance, strike, and not falling over.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The training puppets are enchanted to fight back. Gently. Mostly gently. Break three and we'll talk.

objectives.text: Defeat the training puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! Your sword follows your body, {junior}!

objectives.text: Face the puppets' second wave

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Oh, did I forget to mention? They come back in pairs after the first set. Surprise!

objectives.text: Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Three puppets! Elder Mo owes me a bun. I bet him you'd manage two.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You bet on me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I bet on everyone. It keeps life interesting. Here, take this. Real fighters need real rice.

quests.title: A Rival's Sneer
quests.summary: Zhao Kang of the wealthy Zhao clan has decided that you are beneath him. His attendants want to prove it.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons in the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: So you're the village brat with the letter. The Zhao clan paid a thousand spirit stones for my place here.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And you walked in with a scrap of paper and a trinket. The sect has lowered its standards.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The steps were the same height for both of us.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Clever mouth. My attendants will test it. Training ground. Now.

objectives.text: Defeat Zhao Kang's attendants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't damage their faces. They're expensive.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll try to be gentle. Mostly gently.

objectives.text: Tell Senior Brother Wei what happened

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You slapped the Zhao clan's face on your second day? Ha! I'll have to buy you dumplings.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Careful, though. Zhao Kang's not wicked, just raised on gold and flattery. That kind of pride bruises easily.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then maybe it should bruise a little.

quests.title: Breath of Heaven and Earth
quests.summary: Inner disciple Han Xue has been asked to teach you the Azure Cloud breathing method, your first step on the path of cultivation.

objectives.text: Meet Senior Sister Han Xue in the pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Elder Mo asked me to teach you to breathe. Apparently you've been doing it wrong your whole life.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Qi flows everywhere. In the wind, the water, the stone. Cultivators learn to draw it in and keep it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go to the stone bridge. Water and air meet there, and the qi is gentle. Sit. Listen.

objectives.text: Meditate on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Breathe in. The cool of the pond, the scent of lotus. Something bright stirs beneath your navel.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your pendant grows warm against your chest, as if it too were breathing.

objectives.text: Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You felt it? The first time, most people only feel their legs going numb.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was like a spark. And my pendant grew warm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Warm? Hm. Jade doesn't usually do that. Tell no one but the elders, {junior}.

quests.title: Herbs of the West Terrace
quests.summary: Elder Hua of the Medicine Hall needs spirit herbs from the terraces, and her apprentice Xiao Man needs rescuing from herself.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You're the new one Han Xue mentioned. Good. My hands are full and my apprentice's hands are... enthusiastic.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Gather five spirit herbs from the terraces. Pull them at the root, gently, the way you'd lift a sleeping child.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs on the terraces
Find Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Oh no, oh no. Elder Hua's herbs went in the pond. The carp ate two. I think they're enlightened now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry, I picked extra. Here.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver! I'm Xiao Man. My brother Xiao Shi is an outer disciple too, but he's home in Qingshi.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He promised to write every week. It's been a month. He's probably too busy eating Mother's cooking.

objectives.text: Deliver the herbs to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Five herbs, roots intact, and my apprentice still dry. You have a careful hand.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Careful hands make good alchemists and better friends. Take this pill. It will ease your meridians.

quests.title: The Scripture Pagoda
quests.summary: Elder Bai, keeper of the seven-tier scripture library, will lend you a cultivation manual if you help him find some wandering jade slips.

objectives.text: Visit Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A visitor! Do you read? Can you read? Do you return things? Two out of three and we'll get along.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I was airing the old jade slips and I dozed off. The mountain wind took three into the plum garden.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Bring them back and I'll lend you the Azure Cloud Breathing Manual. The good edition, with footnotes.

objectives.text: Recover the jade slips in the plum garden
Peek at the slips in the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Most of the slips are breathing exercises. One is a list of Elder Bai's favourite teas, annotated with fierce opinions.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last is older, its jade gone milky. It shows two sects' banners side by side: an azure cloud and a green lotus.

objectives.text: Return the jade slips to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: All three! And no corners folded. You may live.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: This one here is old history. The Verdant Lotus Sect, who stood beside our founder three centuries ago.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What happened to them?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: They bled so that this land might sleep. Now nobody remembers their name. That is the fate of heroes, mostly.

quests.title: The Formation Array
quests.summary: Elder Mo shows you the great formation array in the plaza, the heart of the sect's defences, and its lamps need oil.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the formation array

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: This array links to a greater one, far below the mountains. It is called the Azure Heaven Seal.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: What it seals is none of your business yet. What IS your business is that the spirit lamps are dry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Someone overturned the oil cart in the pine woods. Monkeys, the gate disciple claims. Fetch four jars.

objectives.text: Recover the lantern oil in the pine woods
Refill the lamps of the formation array

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: As the last lamp flares, the array's runes turn to face you like flowers following the sun.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your pendant blazes green. For a heartbeat you hear distant chanting, and something vast beneath the earth turns over in its sleep.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What... was that?

objectives.text: Elder Gu wants a word

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The array flared. Every rune, all at once. It has not done that in three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You were standing at its heart. Show me that pendant.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's only my mother's jade, Elder.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. A trinket. The array must be aging. Go, disciple, and speak of this to no one.

quests.title: Red Eyes in the Pines
quests.summary: Something howled beyond the sect wall at dusk. Find out what is prowling the pine woods.

objectives.text: Investigate the howling in the pine woods

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Pine needles crunch underfoot. Between the trunks, pairs of eyes glow the colour of fresh blood.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves? This close to the sect?

objectives.text: Drive off the red-eyed wolves
Ring the alarm bell at the gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms across the mountain. Lanterns flare to life in every courtyard.

objectives.text: Wake the gate disciple

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Wha... I'm up! I'm up! I was guarding. With my ears. Very closely.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: There were wolves in the pines, Lu Ping. With red eyes.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Red eyes? That's an old granny story. Red eyes mean the Blood Moon is... oh. Oh no.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves. Their qi was poisoned with blood. That hasn't happened since the Blood Moon Sect fell.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Probably a stray demonic cultivator passing through. Probably. You did well, {junior}. Get some rest.

quests.title: Qi Condensation
quests.summary: Your meridians are ready. With a pill from Elder Hua and the view from the cliff edge, it is time to condense your first qi.

objectives.text: Receive a Qi Gathering Pill from Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Mo says you're ready. He said it grumpily, which means he's proud.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: This is a Qi Gathering Pill. Swallow it at the cliff edge. The sea of clouds will steady your mind.

objectives.text: Break through at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill dissolves into fire. Qi floods your meridians like a spring thaw, cold, then burning, then clear.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sea of clouds churns below. The scattered spark in your dantian draws tight and becomes a bright, steady pearl of qi.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: So this is Qi Condensation. I can hear the mountain breathing.

objectives.text: Present yourself to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yun Qingyao. Sect Master of the Azure Cloud. I felt your breakthrough from the hall. It was very... loud.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo tells me the formation array answered you, and that wolves with red eyes came to our wall.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Omens come in pairs, they say. I would rather they didn't. Rest well, {player}. Tomorrow the sect needs you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I will not disappoint you, Sect Master.

quests.title: Beyond the Mountain Gate
quests.summary: Elder Gu of the Law Hall has assigned you your first mission outside the sect: gather moonshadow grass in the Whispering Bamboo Forest with Wei Tong.

objectives.text: Receive your mission from Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Medicine Hall needs moonshadow grass. It grows in the Whispering Bamboo, beyond the wolf dens.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Wei Tong will go with you. Take the teleport array outside the gate. Be back within three days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The wolf dens? After what we saw in the pines?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A cultivator who fears wolves should have stayed a farmer. Go.

objectives.text: Watch your arrival in the bamboo forest
Join Wei Tong on the forest path

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Smell that? Bamboo shoots. Wild mushrooms. Freedom. I packed twelve buns, in case of emergencies.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Moonshadow grass grows in the sunny grove ahead. We pick it, we go home, nobody gets eaten.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why do I feel like you've said that before?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Because I have. Twice. Once somebody got eaten. Only a little bit, though.

quests.title: Moonshadow Grass
quests.summary: Gather moonshadow grass in the herb grove. Something in the bamboo is watching.

objectives.text: Find the sunny herb grove

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There! Moonshadow grass. See how it glows? Pick the silver ones. The blue ones make you sneeze for a week.

objectives.text: Gather moonshadow grass in the herb grove
Fight off the spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Wolves! In broad daylight? Back to back, {junior}!

objectives.text: Regroup with Wei Tong by the stream

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves don't hunt at noon. And they don't hunt cultivators. We taste of pills and bad temper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: These weren't red-eyed, at least.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Not yet. Something's driving them out of their den. Let's find out what, then eat. Or eat, then find out.

quests.title: Fangs in the Dark
quests.summary: The spirit wolves are fleeing their own den. Find out what drove them out.

objectives.text: Scout the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hollow reeks of old blood. Bones lie in neat rows, far too neat for wolves.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the cave wall, someone has painted a crescent moon swallowing a sword. The paint is still wet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's not wolf art. Wolves can't hold brushes. I checked once.

objectives.text: Slay the corrupted wolves
Collect fangs from the corrupted wolves
Show the fangs to Wei Tong in the clearing

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The roots are black. Somebody fed these wolves blood, cultivator blood, and on purpose.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Hua can study these. And the den is not empty. Something bigger is still in there.

quests.title: The King of the Den
quests.summary: The wolf king, a spirit beast of great age, has been driven mad by blood qi. End its suffering.

objectives.text: Return to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A howl shakes the bamboo. Something the size of an ox pads out of the cave, eyes like two red lanterns.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted wolf king

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's the wolf king! Its fur used to be silver... they've turned it into a monster!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then let's give it peace.

objectives.text: Lay the wolf king to rest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press a purifying talisman to the great beast's brow. The red drains from its fur, leaving it silver again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Rest easy, old king. It wasn't your fault.

objectives.text: Confront the masked stranger in the clearing

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean work. The wolf king was old when your sect master was a child. It deserved a better death.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Who are you? Did you do this?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: If I had, you would be dead. The wolves were fed blood. Someone is testing an old recipe.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go home, little disciple. Keep that pendant under your robe. There are eyes in this forest older than mine.

quests.title: The Hermit of the Bamboo
quests.summary: The wolf king's claws left Wei Tong with a festering wound. A hermit is said to live in a quiet clearing nearby.

objectives.text: Carry Wei Tong to the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If I die, tell my mother I died heroically. And tell the kitchen to stop making the bitter melon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're not dying. You're just heavy.

objectives.text: Beg the hermit for help

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Wolf king claws. Blood-soaked, too. Put him down on the mat, not on my tea.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The wound drinks qi. It needs water from the spirit spring, drawn by someone with a clean heart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll go. Where is it?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Follow the sound of the frogs. They are loud and very proud of it.

objectives.text: Draw water from the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The water glows where your gourd touches it. The lotus pads turn slowly toward you, then toward your pendant.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: For a moment the spring shows a reflection that is not yours: a woman in green robes, holding a lotus. Then it is gone.

objectives.text: Pick lotus leaves by the spring for the poultice
Bring the spring water to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The spring gave you water. It usually just gives people wet boots.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your friend will live, and complain, which is how you know he is alive.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That jade you carry... no. Old men see ghosts everywhere. Mind the ruins to the north, child. They remember.

quests.title: Smoke on the Ridge
quests.summary: Wei Tong, recovered and ravenous, smells campfire smoke. Someone is camped deep in the forest.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong on the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm alive! And I smell roast pork. Either I've died and gone somewhere nice, or there's a camp nearby.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bandits, probably. The rogue cultivator kind. Let's take a look from the ridge before we do anything stupid.

objectives.text: Scout the camp from the lookout

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below: tents, a fire, crates stamped with a merchant guild's seal. And cages. Cages full of mortals.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Those are townsfolk. Look at their clothes. Qingshi, maybe. What do bandits want with farmers?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nothing good. We free them tonight.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Tonight. Right. After dinner. Kidding! Mostly kidding.

objectives.text: Wait for nightfall and steady your breath

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fire burns low. The guards trade places. Inside the cages, a child is crying very quietly.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Camp
quests.summary: Raid the bandit camp and free the caged mortals.

objectives.text: Raid the bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Sect brats! On your feet, you drunks! Iron-Fang Tie Hu doesn't lose cargo!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They're people, not cargo.

objectives.text: Free the caged mortals

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock snaps. The prisoners stumble out, blinking, too frightened to cry.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: An old farmer grips your sleeve. They took us from Qingshi, he whispers. Every new moon, more of us vanish.

objectives.text: Cover the prisoners' escape

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Kill them! The buyer pays for heads, whole or not!

objectives.text: Recover the stolen spirit stones

quests.title: The Blood-Red Token
quests.summary: Iron-Fang fled, leaving his strongbox behind. Search it for clues about his mysterious buyer.

objectives.text: Search the bandit chief's strongbox

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Silver, forged papers, and at the bottom a token of blood-red jade, carved with a moon swallowing a sword.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It is cold as a corpse. Your pendant flares green, and the token hisses like a burnt insect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The same mark as the den. This is no ordinary bandit's loot.

objectives.text: Show the token to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: A moon eating a sword. My grandmother used to scare me with that. Be good or the Blood Moon takes you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The hermit's old. Older than old. If anyone knows what this is, he does.

objectives.text: Ask the hermit about the token

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Put that thing down. Not on my tea! Not on anything I love.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That is a Blood Moon Sect command token. Three hundred years ago, one of those could order a city to bleed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon Sect was destroyed. Everyone says so.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Everyone says a great many things. The dead are rarely consulted. Take it to your elders. Quickly.

quests.title: Ambush at the Old Bridge
quests.summary: Iron-Fang wants his token back, and he has brought friends.

objectives.text: Survive the ambush on the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That token isn't yours, brat. Hand it over and I'll leave you both your legs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Come and take it, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Brave. I like brave. Brave screams louder.

objectives.text: Search the fallen bandits for clues
Speak with the masked wanderer at the stream

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang ran again. He is a coward with good instincts, which is the most dangerous kind.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You found a Blood Moon token. Do you know how many people will kill for that? Now more will.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then help me. Tell me what's happening.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon rises. That is all you need to know. Tell your sect master, and trust fewer people than you'd like.

quests.title: Report to the Law Hall
quests.summary: Return to the sect with the Blood Moon token and report to the Law Hall.

objectives.text: Return to the Azure Cloud Sect

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Home! I can smell the kitchens from here. Tell Elder Gu about the token, I'll tell the cook about my stomach.

objectives.text: Present the token to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A Blood Moon command token. Where did a bandit get this?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: His buyer, I think. They're kidnapping mortals from Qingshi. And a masked man warned us the Blood Moon is rising.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Rumours and masks. The Law Hall will take this into custody and investigate. Properly. Hand it over.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You did well, disciple. Now forget you ever saw it. That is an order.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Mo about the mission

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu took the token? Well, it is his right. The Law Hall handles matters of the demonic path.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Still. Kidnapped mortals, fed wolves, command tokens. I don't like the shape of this.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I'll speak to the Sect Master. Wei Tong says you carried him on your back. Hmph. Good.

quests.title: The Town That Whispers
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you and Han Xue to Qingshi Town, where the freed captives say people vanish every new moon.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's orders

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The captives you freed are from Qingshi. They say someone takes people every new moon, and nobody stops it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall is investigating the token. I want eyes in the town. Han Xue will go with you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mortals are not our subjects, {player}. They are our reason. Remember that.

objectives.text: Watch your arrival at Qingshi Town
Speak with the constable at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Cultivators. Finally. I sent three petitions to the yamen and two to the gods. You're the first to answer.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Eleven people in four months. Farmers, a fisherman's boy, a young man from your sect visiting his mother.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: From our sect?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Said his name was Xiao Shi. Asked too many questions. Then one morning he didn't come back from the river.

quests.title: The Drunken Crane
quests.summary: Every rumour in Qingshi passes through the Drunken Crane Inn. Then pay your respects to the magistrate.

objectives.text: Walk the main street of Qingshi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shutters close as you pass. A mother pulls her son indoors. The town looks at your sect robes like a sick man at a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're afraid. Not of us. Of whatever makes people disappear.

objectives.text: Ask Madam Fang for gossip at the inn

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Immortals in my inn! Sit, sit. Wine is ten coppers, noodles are five, gossip is free but you must tip.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: People vanish at the new moon, yes. And the temple keeper buries whoever the river gives back.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Poor Keeper Hong. Such a gentle old man. He cries at every funeral, even the dogs'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The river gives some of them back?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Only bits, dear. Only bits. More wine?

objectives.text: Pay respects to Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Ah, the immortals. Welcome, welcome. As you can see, the yamen has matters entirely in hand.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: People wander off. Mortals are like that. Gambling, debts, pretty widows in other towns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Eleven of them, Magistrate?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: A rounded number! Bring me proof, and the yamen will act. Until then, please don't frighten the tax base.

quests.title: A Mother's Grief
quests.summary: A widow at the town well lost her son to the new moon. The ferryman may have seen something on the river.

objectives.text: Comfort the widow at the well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My Liu Er went to fetch the nets at dusk. The river was calm. He swam like a fish, my boy.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: They say he drowned. His body never came back. The river gives back everyone eventually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll find out what happened to him. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Don't promise, young immortal. Promises are heavy. Just look. That's enough.

objectives.text: Question the old ferryman at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Seen something? Forty years on this water, I've seen everything twice.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: New moon, two months back. Lanterns moving on the far bank, toward the hill graves. Pale folk, carrying sacks.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Sacks that wriggled. I told the magistrate. He told me to drink less. I drink exactly the right amount.

objectives.text: Search the river bank

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among the reeds: a broken sandal, a torn net, and footprints leading uphill, pressed deep, as if carrying weight.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Five people. One dragged. Toward the graveyard.

objectives.text: Test the well water for blood qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The well water is clean. Whatever took the townsfolk did not poison them. It wanted them healthy.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Healthy blood. That's worse, somehow.

quests.title: Market of Rumours
quests.summary: Blood lotus is a demonic herb, yet someone in Qingshi is buying it by the crate. Follow the money.

objectives.text: Listen to the gossip in the market square

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Smell that? Beneath the fried dough. Blood lotus. It's used in demonic pills.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's coming from the guild carts. They're heading to the warehouse.

objectives.text: Question Merchant Jin at the warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Jin Baoshan, master of the merchant guild. What an honour. Buying? Selling? Leaving?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Blood lotus? Never heard of it. Is it a flower? We deal in silk, tea and entirely legal things.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your crates are dripping red, Master Jin.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Imported beets. Very juicy. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. Anywhere.

objectives.text: Search the guild's crates

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the silk bolts: dried blood lotus, bundled by the dozen, and a ledger.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every entry is paid in silver by a buyer who signs with a crescent moon. Deliveries: the hill graves, at the new moon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The graveyard again. Jin knows exactly who he's selling to.

quests.title: The Back Alley
quests.summary: A scream in the night. Somebody is being taken right now.

objectives.text: Follow the scream into the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Masked figures in black and crimson drag a struggling woman toward the town wall.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Demonic cultivators. Inside the town walls. {player}, left side. I'll take the right.

objectives.text: Rescue the woman from the demonic cultivators
Pick up the talismans the attackers dropped
Regroup with Han Xue on the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sleep talismans. Blood-ink. These people know the town, the patrols, even which windows don't lock.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And I saw someone on the rooftops, watching. A masked man. He didn't help. He didn't run either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I've met him. In the bamboo forest. He warned me about the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A man who knows that much about demons... either hunts them, or is one.

quests.title: The Masked Stranger
quests.summary: Han Xue suspects the masked wanderer. Madam Fang says a masked guest has been renting her top room.

objectives.text: Ask Madam Fang about the masked guest

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The mask? Pays in old coins, never eats, never drinks, never smiles. My ideal guest, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: He goes up the watchtower every night and stares at the fields. Romantic, or murderous. Could be both.

objectives.text: Climb the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the tower, the terraced fields shine under a thin moon. A lone figure stands among the rice, looking up at you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He knows we're here. He wants us to come.

objectives.text: Confront the masked wanderer in the fields

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've been talking about me. I'm flattered. Also, you're wrong.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then explain why you're always near demons.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Because I hunt them. I've tracked this nest for a year. Ask who tends the dead in this town.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The temple keeper? Everyone says he's gentle.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Everyone said I was gentle once, too. Look beneath his graves. Then decide who to trust.

quests.title: Lanterns Among the Graves
quests.summary: Search the hillside graveyard, where the ledger's deliveries and the ferryman's lanterns both lead.

objectives.text: Search the hillside graveyard at night

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fresh graves, far too many. Each mound is marked with a neat temple tablet and a sprig of dried blood lotus.

objectives.text: Examine the rune circle beneath the graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush the soil aside. The graves are empty, and beneath them runs a circle of blood-ink runes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A blood-gathering formation. Whoever's buried here never died here. They were taken somewhere, alive.

objectives.text: Gather the blood-ink rune stones as proof
Decide what to do with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The tablets are temple tablets. Only Keeper Hong carves these.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Madam Fang said he cries at every funeral.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Some people cry at funerals because they're sad. Others because they're hungry. Let's pay him a visit.

quests.title: The Temple Keeper
quests.summary: Visit Keeper Hong at the town temple, and watch his hands.

objectives.text: Visit Keeper Hong at the temple

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Young immortals! Come in, come in. Tea? It's a special blend. Very calming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It smells of blood lotus, Keeper.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Does it? Old nose, old tea. Such strong young cultivators. Such... vigorous blood.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: And that pendant. Green jade, lotus-carved. Oh, the Patriarch will be so very pleased with me.

objectives.text: Watch the temple keeper reveal himself
Fight through Hong's acolytes on the main street

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Hold them, my children! I must prepare the graves!

quests.title: Blood Beneath the Graves
quests.summary: Keeper Hong, a deacon of the Blood Moon, has fled to his blood formation in the graveyard. The magistrate can no longer look away.

objectives.text: Rally the magistrate

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The temple keeper? I had tea with him every week! He blessed my house! He... he blessed my house.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I was a fool and a coward. The yamen guards are yours. Tell me what to do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep the townsfolk indoors. We'll end this tonight.

objectives.text: Storm the graveyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune circle burns red. Keeper Hong stands at its centre, his kindly face peeling away like wet paper.

objectives.text: Defeat Deacon Hong of the Blood Moon

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Three hundred hearts I have gathered for the Patriarch. Yours will make it three hundred and one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your patriarch is dead.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Dead? Oh, child. He is only hungry.

objectives.text: Follow the dying deacon to his temple

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Too late. The taken are already in the Abyss. The Blood Moon Abyss. Their blood drips on the seal as we speak.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: You think your sect protects you? The Patriarch has friends in high halls. Very high.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Lotus-bearer... he is coming for you. He has always been coming for you.

quests.title: A Debt of Qingshi
quests.summary: Qingshi is safe for now. Keep your word to the town before you return to the sect.

objectives.text: Tell Widow Liu the truth

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your son didn't drown. He was taken. To a place called the Blood Moon Abyss. He may still be alive.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Alive? Don't... don't give me hope unless you mean it, immortal.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I mean it. I'll look for him. For him and for everyone they took.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Then I'll keep the water sweet until you do.

objectives.text: Accept Madam Fang's thanks

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The heroes of Qingshi! Free noodles for life. Well, for a year. Well, one bowl. Today. Eat quickly.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Truly, dear. Thank you. That old snake served me tea for ten years. I'll be checking my teeth for a month.

objectives.text: Cleanse the defiled temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You burn clean incense and let your qi wash through the hall. The smell of blood lotus fades, and a sparrow returns to the eaves.

objectives.text: Head home with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He said the Patriarch has friends in high halls. Very high.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You think someone in our sect...

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I think we should say it only to the Sect Master. And we should find out where Xiao Shi is before his sister does.

quests.title: Missing Pages
quests.summary: The Sect Master wants to know everything about the Blood Moon Sect. Elder Bai's records should help. Should.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A Blood Moon deacon, three hundred stolen hearts, and a hint of friends in high halls. I will not sleep tonight.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Three centuries ago our founder and the Verdant Lotus Sect sealed the Blood Moon Patriarch beneath the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Bai keeps the records. Learn how the seal was made, {player}. If it is failing, I must know why.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Bai for the Blood Moon records

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon War chronicles? Fourth floor, east shelf, beside the recipes for turtle soup. Do not ask.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Here... hm. Hm! The pages on the Azure Heaven Seal are gone. Cut out. With a very sharp, very tidy blade.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Only elders and the Law Hall may enter the fourth floor. Whoever did this had a pass, and patience.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus built the seal. Their ruins lie in the Whispering Bamboo. Stones cannot be cut out of a book.

objectives.text: Watch the journey to the forgotten ruins
Find the gate of the ancient ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A stone archway rises from the bamboo, choked with vines. Carved lotus flowers climb its pillars.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At its keystone is a single lotus, exactly the shape of the jade at your belt.

quests.title: The Hermit's Secret
quests.summary: The archway will not open for you. The hermit who warned you about the ruins knows more than he admits.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hermit sits outside with two cups of tea already poured. He does not look surprised to see you.

objectives.text: Ask the hermit about the ruins

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You went to the ruins. Of course you did. The young never listen and the old never stop talking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The keystone matches my pendant. You knew. The first time you saw it, you knew.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I did. Sit down. This tea has waited three hundred years. It can wait for one more story.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit's story
Accept the hermit's charge

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My name is Lan Jue. Last disciple of the Verdant Lotus Sect. I ran when my masters died. I have been running ever since.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your pendant is the Lotus Key, half of what binds the Azure Heaven Seal. Your mother was of our blood.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The ruins will test you. Gather the rune stones scattered at the gate, and the arch will know its heir.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could have come with me.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I could have done many things for three hundred years. Go. I will follow when my shame lets me.

quests.title: Stones That Remember
quests.summary: Gather the lotus rune stones and read the old stele at the shrine. Someone has followed you from the sect.

objectives.text: Gather the lotus rune stones around the gate
Deal with Zhao Kang on the forest path

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look so surprised. You're not the only one who can walk through bamboo.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You followed me? From the sect?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Gu ordered me to keep an eye on you. He said you carry something the sect must protect.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Personally, I think it's a waste of my talents. But a Zhao obeys the Law Hall. So. Lead on, village brat.

objectives.text: Read the stele in the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Here the Verdant Lotus gave its heart. With the Azure Cloud we bound the Patriarch Xue Wuji beneath the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seal has two keys. The Lotus Key, which binds. The Azure Eye, which watches. Never let both fall to one hand.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Azure Eye... that's the formation array at home. And the Lotus Key is... your trinket?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Apparently my trinket is older than your clan.

quests.title: Stone Guardians
quests.summary: The ruins' stone sentinels wake at the sound of footsteps. Get past them and open the archway.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone sentinels at the gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stone men! Wonderful. My sword was freshly polished, too.

objectives.text: Set the rune stones into the archway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune stones slide into place one by one. The carved lotus on the keystone opens its petals.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: With a sound like a sigh, the vines fall away and the gate of the Verdant Lotus opens for the first time in three centuries.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It... opened. For you. Fine. FINE. I'm not impressed. I'm slightly impressed.

objectives.text: Step through the opened archway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the arch lies a courtyard of green stone. At its centre kneels a giant statue, head bowed, hands resting on a sword.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please tell me that one doesn't move.

quests.title: The Guardian of the Lotus
quests.summary: The inner courtyard is watched by the last guardian of the Verdant Lotus. It will not accept an heir without a trial.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the shrine

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I followed. My shame is slower than my feet, it turns out.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The guardian in the courtyard was carved by my master. It asks one question with its fists: are you worthy?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Do not fear it. It is not cruel, only very, very thorough.

objectives.text: Stop the sentinels reforming at the gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The sentinels are reforming. Break them again, quickly, before the guardian wakes!

objectives.text: Pass the trial of the ancient guardian

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great statue lifts its head. Moss sloughs from its shoulders. A voice grinds like millstones: who bears the lotus?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I do. {player}, of the Azure Cloud. And of the Verdant Lotus.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then show me that the lotus has not wilted.

quests.title: Legacy of the Lotus
quests.summary: The guardian kneels. The Verdant Lotus left something for its heir.

objectives.text: Open the Verdant Lotus reliquary

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside lies a jade slip carved with lotus roots: the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra, and a letter in an elegant hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: To whoever carries my key. I am sorry for the burden. It was always meant to be shared. Do not carry it alone.

objectives.text: Comprehend the Heart Sutra at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sutra unfolds in your mind like a flower opening underwater. Roots, stem, blossom. Patience, strength, compassion.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi begins to settle, layer upon layer, like silt forming bedrock.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You read it. I can see it in your breathing. The lotus grows in mud and is not stained.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred years I waited for someone to open that box. I thought I would feel relief. I feel... old.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Come back to the sect with me. Tell them what you know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One day. Not yet. First I must forgive a coward, and he is very stubborn.

quests.title: Blood in the Shrine
quests.summary: Blood Moon scouts have followed your trail to the ruins and are defacing the stele.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon scouts from the shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're smashing the stele! Barbarians! That's at least a thousand years of calligraphy!

objectives.text: Check on Zhao Kang at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a scratch. Don't fuss. A Zhao doesn't bleed. We... tactically leak.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You stepped in front of that blade for me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't be sentimental. Nobody gets to defeat you except me. I've been planning it for months.

objectives.text: Gather herbs to treat Zhao Kang's wound

quests.title: The Law Hall's Interest
quests.summary: Back at the sect, everyone wants to see the Heart Sutra. Some want it more than others.

objectives.text: Return to the sect with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Home. I'm going to bathe for three days. Don't tell anyone I helped you. I have a reputation for being unbearable.

objectives.text: Show the Heart Sutra to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra. I have waited my whole life to see this. I may cry. Don't look.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Keep it. It is bound to the Lotus Key and would only sulk in my shelves.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: And the missing pages... the fourth-floor log shows a Law Hall seal. The Law Hall borrows everything. It's how they keep us honest.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Gu's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang tells me you found a Verdant Lotus relic. The Law Hall will take custody of it. For safekeeping.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: With respect, Elder, the Sect Master ordered me to keep it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Did she. Then keep it, disciple. Keep it very close. Things kept close are the easiest to lose.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu wanted the sutra? Don't take it to heart. He's been cold ever since his daughter died. Twenty years now.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu Lan. A bright girl. Meridian sickness. No pill could save her. He searched the whole world.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Grief is a heart demon that never stops whispering. Be patient with him, {junior}. For my sake.

quests.title: Preparing the Foundation
quests.summary: Establishing a foundation takes pills, spirit stones, and a clear conscience. You have one of three.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Hua for a Foundation Pill

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A Foundation Pill needs lotus root from the pond, gathered at dusk, and five spirit stones to fire the cauldron.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The stones come from the treasury. Good luck with that.

objectives.text: Negotiate with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Five spirit stones? Five? Do you know what five spirit stones could buy? Five spirit stones!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's for a Foundation Pill. The Sect Master approved it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Approved it. Everyone approves things. Nobody counts things. Fine. Take them. Sign here. And here. And here.

objectives.text: Gather lotus root at the pond at dusk
Tell Xiao Man what you learned in Qingshi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're back! Did you go through Qingshi? Did you see my brother? Did he say why he hasn't written?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Xiao Man... Xiao Shi was taken. By the same people who took the townsfolk. I think he's alive.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Taken? But he... he's so bad at fighting. He faints at the sight of needles.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Promise me you'll bring him back. No. Don't promise. Just... do it. Please.

quests.title: Foundation Establishment
quests.summary: With the Foundation Pill in hand and Han Xue standing guard, build the foundation of your dao.

objectives.text: Ask Han Xue to guard your breakthrough

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breakthroughs attract trouble. Heart demons, jealous juniors, very curious elders. I'll stand guard.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The plum garden is quiet at night, and Zhao Kang is too injured to sulk there. Go.

objectives.text: Establish your foundation in the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi pours downward like a waterfall into your dantian, and there it hardens, layer upon layer, into a foundation of jade.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the plum blossoms, a single green lotus flickers into being around you, and slowly sinks into your heart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I can feel every blossom on every branch. Is this what the elders feel all the time?

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's news

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Foundation Establishment, and a Verdant Lotus sutra. You grow faster than my worries, {player}. Barely.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In one month the sect holds the Inner Sect Tournament. The winner earns a place at my side, and the Azure Eye's trust.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I want you to enter. And I want whoever cut those pages to watch you win.

quests.title: Banners on the Mountain
quests.summary: The Inner Sect Tournament begins. Register with the Treasury Steward, then catch up on the gossip at the gate.

objectives.text: Watch the opening of the Inner Sect Tournament
Take in the tournament stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Banners of every peak ring the plaza. Disciples crowd the walls and railings. Someone is selling roasted chestnuts at twice the price.

objectives.text: Register with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Registration fee: two spirit stones. Non-refundable. Especially if you lose. Particularly if you die.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The Sect Master told me to enter. Personally.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Then the Sect Master can pay. Fine, fine. Waived. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

objectives.text: Hear the gossip from Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The betting pool is open! Yan Tie, three-time champion, two to one. Zhao Kang, five to one.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're at nine to one. I put three stones on you. Don't tell Steward Qian. Actually, win, then tell him.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Oh, and Elder Gu is supervising the pill supplies this year. First time ever. Very thorough man.

quests.title: Sharpening the Blade
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on one last training session before the preliminary round.

objectives.text: Train with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Right. Foundation Establishment. So the puppets need to be angrier. I've had them tuned up.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Four at once. If you get hit, you buy lunch. If you don't get hit, I buy lunch. Either way, lunch.

objectives.text: Defeat four enhanced training puppets
Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Not a scratch. I'm buying lunch. I'm always buying lunch. How did this happen to me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen. Yan Tie is strong, but he fights like a landslide, all at once. Make him chase you and he'll tire.

quests.title: The Preliminary Round
quests.summary: Three opponents on the formation plaza. Elder Mo is referee, and he does not believe in mercy.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo, the referee

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Rules: no killing, no crippling, no weeping on the formation. Last one standing advances.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: And {junior}? Don't embarrass me. I told the other elders you were adequate.

objectives.text: Win the preliminary round

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Begin!

objectives.text: Win the deciding bout of your bracket

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Two more from Cloud Peak who think they were robbed. Settle it.

objectives.text: Receive Elder Mo's verdict

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Hmph. Don't let it go to your head. Heads are heavy enough already.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Was that a compliment, Elder Mo?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: It was an observation. Go and eat something. You look like a boiled noodle.

quests.title: Whispers at Night
quests.summary: Zhao Kang slipped out through the moon gate after curfew. Follow him.

objectives.text: Follow Zhao Kang to the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A figure in gold-trimmed robes slips through the moon gate, carrying a bundle of incense sticks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sneaking out the night before the second round? What are you up to, Zhao Kang?

objectives.text: Confront Zhao Kang at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go ahead. Report me to the Law Hall. It's what they're for.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My elder brother Zhao Ming died a year ago tonight. A Law Hall mission. Bandits, they said, in the bamboo forest.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I burn incense here because he liked the view. That's all. That's all it is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, Zhao Kang. Who assigned his mission?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Gu. Same as yours. Why does that matter?

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Ming. I remember him. He was kind. He was also ambushed in exactly the place you were ambushed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Elder Gu assigned both missions. The Law Hall held the Blood Moon token. Law Hall seals are on the missing pages.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That isn't proof. It's a pattern. I'll watch the Law Hall. You win the tournament. Don't let him see you suspect.

quests.title: The Hundred-Disciple Melee
quests.summary: The second round is a melee on the plaza. Wei Tong was knocked out early and is taking it well. Mostly.

objectives.text: Console Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Eliminated. By a girl half my size who hid behind a banner and poked me in the kidney. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Honestly, it was brilliant. I'm going to learn it. Go on. Avenge my kidney.

objectives.text: Survive the melee

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Second round! Everyone against everyone! Try not to hit the audience!

objectives.text: Help Lu Ping gather his scattered winnings
Collect Lu Ping's thanks

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're into the semifinal! I've won eleven stones! I'm rich! I'm going to buy a hat!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Also, a Law Hall disciple told me to stop betting on you. Rude, right? I bet more.

quests.title: The Poisoned Cup
quests.summary: Elder Hua has found something wrong with the tournament pills.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's urgent summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Frenzy Pills. Blood lotus and wolf's bane, hidden inside Vitality Pills. They burn a cultivator from the inside.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Three boxes were meant for the finalists' quarters. I need four moonbell herbs to brew an antidote. Hurry.

objectives.text: Gather moonbell herbs for the antidote
Ask Xiao Man what she saw

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The pill boxes? A disciple in Law Hall grey carried them in. He said Elder Gu approved them personally.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: One box went to Yan Tie's room. He's the champion. He's so strong already, why would he need pills?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe he doesn't know what's in them.

objectives.text: Deliver the herbs to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Good. I'll brew the antidote tonight. If Yan Tie has taken a Frenzy Pill, he will not know friend from foe.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Tell no one about the Law Hall yet. An accusation without proof is just a very loud way to die.

quests.title: Partners in the Semifinal
quests.summary: The semifinal is a paired bout, and fate has a sense of humour: your partner is Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Find your partner in the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Of all the disciples in all the peaks. Fine. Stay on my left. Don't slow me down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're still limping from the shrine.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Then stay on my right. Whatever. Just win.

objectives.text: Win the paired semifinal with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Five of them? Good. I was worried this would be boring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On your left, Zhao Kang!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I SEE them!

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You fight like a farmer. Stubborn, unpolished, impossible to knock over.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was a compliment. Don't get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Win the final. If anyone is going to beat Yan Tie, it should be the person who's going to lose to me someday.

quests.title: Eve of the Final
quests.summary: The night before the final, Elder Gu summons you. It is not about the tournament.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Gu's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Congratulations on reaching the final. An unlikely journey for a village orphan.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tournament rules forbid external artifacts. Bring your pendant to the Law Hall tonight for inspection.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's not an artifact, Elder. It's a family keepsake.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Then you have nothing to fear. The Law Hall. Tonight. Do not make me ask again.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Mo about the rule

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Inspection? There's no such rule. There never has been. I wrote half the tournament rules myself.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu... no. He is grieving, not wicked. Still. Don't go. If he asks, tell him I forbade it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go and clear your head. You've a champion to face at dawn.

objectives.text: Steady your dao heart on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pond is still. The moon lies in it, whole. You breathe until your heart lies as still as the water.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue in the pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu asked for the pendant? Then he's run out of patience. That makes him dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Win tomorrow. I'll be watching the pagoda. If the Law Hall moves while everyone watches the final, I'll know.

quests.title: The Final Bout
quests.summary: Face Yan Tie, three-time champion of the Inner Sect Tournament. Something is wrong with his eyes.

objectives.text: Step up for the final

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The final! {player} of the Outer Court against Yan Tie of Thunder Peak, champion three years running!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bow to your opponent. Bow to the Sect Master. And for heaven's sake, bow to me.

objectives.text: Defeat the tournament champion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Yan Tie bows, and when he straightens, his eyes are the colour of blood. Veins crawl black up his neck.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Frenzy qi! Stop the bout... no, he won't stop now. {player}, bring him down without killing him!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll try. Stay back, everyone!

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's judgement

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yan Tie will live. Elder Hua's antidote reached him in time. You fought to save him, not to win. I saw that.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The victory is yours, and with it, a place at my side. But someone fed him that pill.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wait. The pagoda bell... someone is ringing the pagoda bell. Where is Han Xue?

quests.title: The Law Hall's Shadow
quests.summary: While the whole sect watched the final, someone broke into the scripture pagoda.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}! Elder Bai's been hurt. It's Gu. Gu is in the pagoda. The seal diagram, he's taking the seal diagram!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Stay here. I'll stop him.

objectives.text: Confront the traitor
Defeat the traitor's Blood Moon accomplices

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Hold them. The pendant can wait. The diagram cannot.

objectives.text: Check on the wounded Elder Bai on the plaza

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I'm fine. I've been hit harder by falling bookshelves. Gu Hanshan... forty years we've shared tea.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He took the Azure Heaven Seal diagram. The master copy. The one we would need to repair the seal.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Without it, if the seal breaks, we cannot remake it. Go to the Sect Master. Quickly.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master at the teleport array

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He fled through the teleport array. Its last destination was the Blood Moon Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty years I trusted him with our law. I trusted him with our children.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest tonight, {player}. Tomorrow we go into the Abyss after him.

quests.title: An Unlikely Guide
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you and Han Xue after the traitor. A masked stranger waits at the gate with an offer.

objectives.text: Receive your orders from the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Abyss is a wound in the world. A sect army would be seen for a hundred miles. Two disciples might not.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Find Gu. Find the captives. Do not face the Patriarch's servants alone if you can help it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And {player}... come back. That is not a request.

objectives.text: Meet the masked wanderer at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You'll need a guide. The Abyss eats people who don't know where to step.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why should we trust you?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You shouldn't. But I know the Abyss. I was born to it. I'll show you the way down, and you decide the rest.

objectives.text: Descend into the Blood Moon Abyss
Enter the crimson canyon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The air is warm and wet, and tastes of copper. Somewhere far below, a drum beats slowly, like a heart.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's not a drum.

quests.title: The Field of Bones
quests.summary: Cross the plain of bones, where the Blood Moon's sentries hunt.

objectives.text: Cross onto the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bones crunch underfoot, bleached white under the red moon. Dead trees claw at the sky.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The sentries listen for the crack of bone.

objectives.text: Clear the sentries on the field of bones
Collect the sentries' demon cores
Talk with Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You fight well. You hesitate before the killing blow. That will get you killed here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They were people once, weren't they?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Children stolen from villages. Raised on blood and fear. I was one. The Patriarch took my name when I was six.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming. It means nameless night. I chose it myself. It is the only thing here I ever chose.

quests.title: The Blood Pools
quests.summary: The miasma from the blood pools eats at your qi. Blood lotus growing there can neutralise it, if you can stand the smell.

objectives.text: Harvest blood lotus from the steaming pools
Drive off the blood-fed wolves drinking at the pools
Purify the lotus and steady your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus hisses in your palm. You draw on the Heart Sutra. Mud, root, blossom. The red fades to a clean, pale pink.

objectives.text: Share the purified lotus with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It tastes like rust and flowers. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't trust him. But he hasn't led us into a trap yet. That's either honesty or patience.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Or both. People can be both.

quests.title: Ambush at the Obelisks
