quests.summary: A ring of obelisks pulses with stolen blood. Investigate it, carefully.

objectives.text: Examine the demonic obelisk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl across the black stone like beetles. Thin threads of blood run from the obelisks down into the dark.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They pull the life out of the prisoners and pour it into the altar. Every drop weakens your seal.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guard ambush

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: Little lambs from the Azure Cloud. And one lost puppy, come home at last. Hello, Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Xue Mei. Crimson Elder. Stay close to me.

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: I'll take the pretty ice sword for the cages. Kill the rest.

objectives.text: Regroup with Ye Wuming by the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They took Han Xue. Xue Mei wanted her alive. Her blood is pure. They'll put her in the cages.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we go to the cages. Now.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not now. The obelisks will sense you. Break them first, or the cages will drain her before we arrive.

quests.title: Shattering the Obelisks
quests.summary: Ye Wuming knows a counter-rune. Gather the rune fragments and break the obelisk ring.

objectives.text: Collect rune fragments around the obelisks
Shatter the heart obelisk with the counter-rune

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press the fragments to the obelisk in Ye Wuming's pattern. Your pendant blazes. The black stone cracks like ice.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one, the obelisks crumble. Far off, in the dark, many voices gasp at once, like people breathing for the first time in days.

objectives.text: Deal with the guards drawn by the noise
Confer with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The cages are past the war camp. They'll be expecting us now. Good. Expecting and ready are different things.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You could have left me at your sect gate. Why didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because you've never lied to me. Not once. That's rare.

quests.title: The War Camp
quests.summary: The Blood Moon war camp stands between you and the cages. Its command tent may hold answers.

objectives.text: Approach the war camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crimson banners, black tents, and drums. Hundreds of warriors drill in silent rows.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The command tent is at the centre. Where there are orders, there are answers.

objectives.text: Break through the Blood Moon war camp
Seize the sealed letters from the command tent
Read the letters with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This one is orders. A siege on Qingshi Town, with Iron-Fang's bandits, before the next blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This one is in Gu's hand. To the Patriarch. The diagram is delivered. Remember your promise. Remember Lan.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Lan? Gu Lan was his daughter. She died twenty years ago.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Patriarch makes many promises to grieving fathers. He keeps very few.

quests.title: The Iron Cages
quests.summary: The prison cages hold every missing soul from Qingshi, and Han Xue.

objectives.text: Reach the prison cages

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron cages hang over a pit, each one crowded with pale, silent people. Somewhere a man is singing a lullaby, badly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The guards change at the red hour. That's now. Go.

objectives.text: Defeat the cage wardens
Break open the cages

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: About time. I was starting to compose my death poem. It was very good. Nobody will ever hear it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Farmers, fishermen, disciples of three sects. A young man with Xiao Man's eyes. And a boy who says his name is Liu Er.

quests.title: What the Prisoners Saw
quests.summary: The prisoners are free, but weak. Some of them have seen the altar.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You're from the sect? My sister... is Xiao Man all right? Is she eating? She forgets to eat.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I followed the lanterns from the river. They caught me at the graves. They've been bleeding us for weeks.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: An elder from our sect was here. Gu. He stood by the altar and talked to the blood like it was a person.

objectives.text: Recover stolen medicine for the prisoners
Send the prisoners home with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'll lead them out. Ye Wuming marked the path. You two go to the altar.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And {player}? If Gu is there... don't hesitate. He won't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Get them home safe, Senior Sister. We'll be right behind you.

quests.title: The Altar of Blood
quests.summary: At the great altar, the stolen blood flows into the seal. The traitor is there, and he is not alone.

objectives.text: Witness the ritual at the Altar of Blood
Defeat Crimson Elder Xue Mei

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: You broke my obelisks and stole my lambs. I'll wear your skin to the Patriarch's awakening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You'll have to catch me first.

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: Oh, I love it when they run.

objectives.text: Disrupt the blood ritual

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You drive the Lotus Key against the altar. Green light floods the channels of blood, and the ritual chokes and dies.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Far below, something vast roars in frustration. The whole abyss shudders.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Gu is gone. Fled deeper. But you've bought the seal time. Months, maybe.

quests.title: Core Formation
quests.summary: The battle has pushed your qi to its limit. In the deepest part of the abyss, forge your golden core, then bring the news home.

objectives.text: Decide the fate of the captured acolytes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: These three surrendered. Children, really. Blood Moon trained. The sect would execute them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They were stolen, like you. Take them. Teach them their own names.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...You are a strange cultivator, {player}. Very well. I will try.

objectives.text: Form your golden core in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Killing intent presses from every side. Your foundation cracks, and from the crack rises light.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi spins, tightens, and condenses into a golden core, bright as a small sun in the dark of the abyss.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The darkness can't touch it. I can feel it burning.

objectives.text: Return Xiao Shi to his sister

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Brother! Brother, you idiot, you absolute idiot, you never wrote!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: There were no brushes in the cage, Man Man.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}, I... thank you. I'll pick herbs for you for a hundred years. I'll only drop some of them.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A golden core, the captives freed, and the ritual broken. You went down a disciple and came back a pillar.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: But Qingshi is next. If the letters are true, the Blood Moon marches before the next blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest one night. Then we defend the town. We will not let it bleed a second time.

quests.title: Smoke on the Horizon
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you to Qingshi with Zhao Kang and Wei Tong. The Blood Moon will arrive within days.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's orders

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take Zhao Kang and Wei Tong. The sect must hold the mountain in case this is a feint, so you three are the vanguard.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hold Qingshi until the moon wanes. Whatever it costs, don't let them turn the town into another graveyard.

objectives.text: Watch the Blood Moon host approach Qingshi
Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The immortals! Good. I have forty guards, three hundred farmers and one very old ballista.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I was a coward once, and a monster fed on my town while I drank his tea. Not twice. Tell me where to stand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right here, Magistrate. People need to see you standing.

quests.title: Walls and Wards
quests.summary: The walls are old, the guards are few, and Merchant Jin's warehouse is full of lamp oil he refuses to share.

objectives.text: Plan the defence with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The gate will hold for an hour against cultivators. Maybe. Fire will buy us more. We need oil for the wall braziers.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Jin's warehouse has barrels of it. He says it's for export. I say it's for not dying.

objectives.text: Persuade Merchant Jin to open his warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: My oil? That's six months' profit! Who compensates me? The yamen? The yamen owes me for the ballista!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You sold blood lotus to the people who took eleven of your neighbours. You owe this town more than oil.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: ...That was business. I didn't know. I didn't want to know.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Take it. Take all of it. Maybe it will weigh a little less on the scales in the next life.

objectives.text: Carry the oil barrels to the wall
Paint warding talismans on the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You paint the gate posts with cinnabar wards. Constable Du watches, then quietly paints a few crooked ones of his own.

quests.title: The Watchtower
quests.summary: Climb the watchtower and sound the alarm when the host arrives.

objectives.text: Climb the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Torches, thousands of them, flow over the far hills like a burning river. Blood Moon banners, and bandit flags beside them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's... a lot of torches. I'm going to need a bigger lunch.

objectives.text: Ring the alarm bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Doors slam. Children are carried to the temple. Old men pick up hoes and stand in the street.

objectives.text: Take your positions with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'll hold the east wall. Wei Tong takes the south. You go wherever it's worst. That's what you're good at.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And if I die, tell my clan I died beautifully. Specify beautifully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nobody's dying today, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. From your lips to heaven's ears.

quests.title: Raiders in the Fields
quests.summary: The bandits strike the farmland first, to burn the harvest and scatter the farmers.

objectives.text: Ask Old Pan to ferry the farmers to safety

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Ferry the farmers across? At night, with bandits shooting at us? Double fare.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I'm joking. No fare. Forty years on this river, and the first time anyone needed me. Go, I'll bring them over.

objectives.text: Drive the raiders from the fields

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Burn the rice! Burn the barns! Nobody eats this winter unless Iron-Fang says so!

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong at the market kitchens

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The farmers are across? Good. I've been guarding the kitchens. Strategically. Armies march on their stomachs.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here, a dumpling. Eat it. Then go and hit something. Elder Mo would want you fed and angry.

quests.title: The Graveyard Flank
quests.summary: Demonic cultivators are trying to wake Deacon Hong's old blood formation beneath the graves.

objectives.text: Break the demonic cultivators at the graves
Slay the blood-fed wolves they brought
Seal the blood formation for good

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press your palm to the rune circle. The Heart Sutra flows from your golden core, and the blood-ink fades to grey dust.

objectives.text: Check on Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The east wall held. Barely. I may have set my own sleeve on fire. It was a tactical fire.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They didn't push the graveyard to take the town. They wanted blood on those runes. Why?

quests.title: The Riverside Assault
quests.summary: Blood Guards come up the river on rafts. Old Pan's ferry is still out on the water.

objectives.text: Race to the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Black rafts slide down the river under the red moon. Out on the water, Old Pan's ferry is still crossing, packed with farmers.

objectives.text: Repel the Blood Guards at the docks
Save the medicine crates washed up on the bank
Bring the medicine to Widow Liu at the well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My Liu Er came home three days ago. Thin as a reed, but home. He talks about a sect disciple who broke his cage.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You didn't promise. You just did it. Now I'll carry water to your wall until my arms fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell Liu Er to stay inside tonight. And give him an extra bowl of rice from me.

quests.title: Treachery at the Warehouse
quests.summary: Bandits are pouring out of a tunnel under the guild warehouse. Merchant Jin knows why.

objectives.text: Catch Merchant Jin in the back alley

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't kill me! I dug that tunnel years ago for smuggling tea! Iron-Fang found out. He threatened my daughters.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I opened it for him tonight. Then I saw you give away my oil to people who'd spat at me. I couldn't...

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Turn me in. I deserve it. But close the tunnel first. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fear made you do it. What you do next is your choice. Go help Constable Du, Master Jin.

objectives.text: Stop the bandits in the warehouse yard
Collapse the smugglers' tunnel

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A talisman flares. The earth groans, and the tunnel folds in on itself with a satisfying thump.

quests.title: Iron-Fang Tie Hu
quests.summary: Iron-Fang himself leads his men into the market square. End this.

objectives.text: Cut down Iron-Fang's lieutenants
Defeat Iron-Fang Tie Hu

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You again! The sect brat who took my token. I've dreamed about this, you know. Every night.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I've heard your men talk, Iron-Fang. The Blood Moon holds their families. Holds yours too.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut up! Shut up and fight!

objectives.text: Decide Iron-Fang's fate at the temple

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, then. Finish it. That's what you sect types do to trash like me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Where are your people's families, Tie Hu?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: In the Abyss. Behind the black gate. I burned villages so they'd keep breathing. Does that make it better? It doesn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Kneel at this temple and swear to fight for the town you tried to burn. Then help me bring your families home.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...You're a fool. Fine. Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

quests.title: The Last Wave
quests.summary: The final wave hits the town gate, and a familiar figure watches from the graveyard hill.

objectives.text: Hold the town gate against the last wave

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They're at the gate! Everyone with a spear, with me! For Qingshi!

objectives.text: Confront Gu Hanshan on the graveyard hill

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Well fought, disciple. Truly. You were always the most stubborn of the new ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why, Elder Gu? Why betray the sect? Why feed children to the Blood Moon?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Patriarch holds my daughter's soul. When the seal breaks, he will give her back. A new body. A new life.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: This siege was never about the town. Every drop spilled here soaks down to the seal. You've helped him, you know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You would do the same for someone you loved. Don't pretend you wouldn't.

objectives.text: Chase Gu into the graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where Gu stood there is only a scorched talisman and the smell of blood. He is gone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. I wouldn't. Not like this.

quests.title: Dawn over Qingshi
quests.summary: The siege is broken. Mourn the fallen, share a meal with the living, and report to the sect.

objectives.text: Accept the magistrate's thanks

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Qingshi stands. Nineteen dead, which is nineteen too many and ten thousand too few for what they intended.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I'm having a stele carved at the gate. Your name will be on it. The yamen will not forget. I will not forget.

objectives.text: Celebrate at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Free wine for the heroes! One cup each. Immortals drink like fish and I'm not a lake.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang is washing dishes in my kitchen, by the way. He's surprisingly good. Very thorough scrubber.

objectives.text: Mourn the fallen at the temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nineteen tablets. Farmers, a guard, a boy who carried arrows. You burn incense for each, and say each name aloud.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You held the town. But Gu was right about one thing: the blood reached the seal. It has cracked again.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We cannot patch it any longer. We must build a new one. The Great Azure Formation, a seal for ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: It needs star iron, thunder crystal and phoenix feathers. They exist in one place: the Celestial Sky Isles.

quests.title: Stairway of Clouds
quests.summary: The Sky Isles have opened. The Sect Master sends you, Han Xue and Zhao Kang to gather materials for the Great Azure Formation.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's orders

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Bai has rebuilt the formation design from the Law Hall archive copy. Elder Mo will build it. You will supply it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Five star iron, five thunder crystals, three phoenix feathers. The isles close again at the next full moon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take Han Xue and Zhao Kang. And {player}? Look at the sky while you're up there. It's good for the soul.

objectives.text: Ascend to the Celestial Sky Isles
Meet the star-gazer at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Visitors. Sixty years, and they still come puffing up the stairs like it's a surprise.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I am Qing Luan. I was a sage of these isles, once. Now I'm mostly a very persistent memory.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The isles test those who cross. Your heart must be clear, your sword sharp, and your shoes sturdy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Two out of three is usually fine. Go on, lotus child. I'll be in my pavilion, watching.

quests.title: The Jade Bridge
quests.summary: Cross the long jade bridge to the second isle. The winds are strong, and you are not alone.

objectives.text: Cross the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's very high. Isn't it very high? Why is there no railing? Who builds a bridge with no railing?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Immortals who can fly, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well, that's elitist.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon pursuers on the bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Moon! They followed us through the array. Gu must have told them where we were going.

objectives.text: Catch your breath with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why follow us here? What do demons want with the materials for a sealing formation?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: To stop us building it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then why did they only watch us, and not attack until we reached the bridge? Something is wrong. I don't know what yet.

quests.title: Isle of Winds
quests.summary: The wind-swept isle is thick with cloud silk, and thick with sword intent for those who can listen.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk from the wind-swept pines
Listen to the wind

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wind has no shape, and so nothing can break it. It bends around every obstacle and arrives anyway.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang among the pines

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've been thinking. It happens occasionally. I've been an insufferable brat to you for two years.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My brother would have liked you. He always said pride is a wall you build to keep yourself small.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: So. I'm sorry. There. Never tell anyone. I'll deny it with my last breath.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Apology accepted, Zhao Kang. Friend.

quests.title: The Star-Gazer's Riddle
quests.summary: Qing Luan will point you to the star iron, if you can answer her riddle. And read her chart. And listen to her complain.

objectives.text: Visit Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A riddle! I've waited sixty years to ask someone. What climbs higher the more you take away?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: A hole? No... a debt? Wait. A cultivator. The more attachments we let go, the higher we rise.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Wrong, but I like your answer better than mine. It was a staircase with the bottom steps removed. Read my chart.

objectives.text: Study the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Constellations drift across the jade. The star iron fell with the palace. The thunder grows where the vein runs.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the chart's corner, a seven-star pattern glows red. It is labelled: the Patriarch's Ladder.

objectives.text: Ask Qing Luan about the red stars

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Three hundred years ago a man called Xue Wuji came here. Very charming. He wanted the Ascension Stair.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He meant to ride the heavenly tribulation into the heavens and take them. Your founders stopped him, barely.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The star iron lies in the fallen palace. Watch out for the guardians. They're rude.

quests.title: Star Iron of the Fallen Palace
quests.summary: The celestial palace fell ten thousand years ago. Its guardians did not get the message.

objectives.text: Reach the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Broken columns tower into the clouds. Among them lie lumps of dark metal, still faintly warm from falling out of the sky.

objectives.text: Defeat the palace guardians
Gather the star iron
Read the palace inscription

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Whoever climbs the stair must carry nothing that is not theirs. Not a stolen body. Not a stolen name. Not a stolen heaven.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stolen body? What kind of warning is that?

quests.title: The Spirit Vein
quests.summary: Thunder crystals grow where the spirit vein breaks the surface. Someone else is already mining them.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon miners from the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Guards, with picks and sacks. They're mining thunder crystals!

objectives.text: Gather thunder crystals
Examine the miners' cache

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crates of thunder crystals, carefully packed, each stamped with the same seven-star mark as the red stars.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals are only good for one thing: channelling heavenly lightning into a formation.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Our formation needs them too. Why would the Blood Moon build the same thing we're building?

quests.title: Garden of Immortals
quests.summary: Phoenix feathers fall in the overgrown garden, where the Jiao serpent hunts.

objectives.text: Enter the overgrown garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blossom trees taller than pagodas. Petals fall like warm snow. High in the branches, something golden rustles its wings.

objectives.text: Gather phoenix feathers in the immortal garden
Heed Qing Luan in the garden

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You have the feathers. Good. Now you have a problem. The Jiao smelled them. It smells everything.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It was a noble beast, guardian of these isles for a thousand years. Then the Blood Moon fed it their blood.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It is suffering. It will kill you because it is suffering. Please free it.

quests.title: The Jiao's Lair
quests.summary: The corrupted flood dragon will not let you leave the isles alive. Face it in its lair.

objectives.text: Enter the serpent's lair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isle shudders. Scales the colour of storm clouds slide past, and a head the size of a house rises over the edge.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Nobody told me the serpent was THAT big.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone told you, Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted Jiao serpent

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Its heart is still in there, lotus child. Strike the blood from it, not the life!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you. Hold on, great one. I'll set you free.

objectives.text: Tend to your wounds with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It looked at you before it sank into the clouds. Not like a beast. Like someone saying thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're shaking. Sit. That's an order from your senior sister, and I rarely give them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You give them constantly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I rarely give them nicely.

quests.title: The Stars Disagree
quests.summary: The Jiao left something behind in its lair, and Qing Luan has something to show you before you go.

objectives.text: Search the Jiao's hoard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among bones and coins lies a heart of star iron the size of a fist, humming with stored lightning.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Its weight settles into your hands like it has been waiting for you.

objectives.text: Prepare to leave with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feather, and a dragon heart. We're rich. We're heroes. We're rich heroes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come on. Wei Tong promised a banquet. I'm told he's been practising dumplings for a month.

objectives.text: Say farewell to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Show me the design your sect intends to build. Hm. Hmm. The stars disagree with it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Here, where it should turn inward, it turns outward. As if it were meant to open rather than close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was rebuilt from the sect's Law Hall archive.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Then ask who kept the archive. Go carefully, lotus child. Heaven is watching you now.

quests.title: Nascent Soul
quests.summary: The winds of the isles have tempered you. At the cloud gate, give birth to your nascent soul, then bring the materials home.

objectives.text: Form your nascent soul at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core cracks, and from it unfolds a tiny figure of light, cross-legged, with your face and a lotus in its hands.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It opens its eyes. For the first time, you see the world twice: with your eyes, and with your soul.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul. Even the clouds look different. They look like they're breathing.

objectives.text: Deliver the materials to Elder Mo at the formation array

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Star iron. Thunder crystal. Phoenix feathers. And a dragon's heart, you show-off. The formation will be finished in a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder, the star-gazer said the design is wrong. That it opens instead of closing. It was taken from the Law Hall archive.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bai checked it against the archive copy, sealed and certified. The Law Hall... hm. Gu kept that archive for thirty years.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Leave it with me. I'll check every rune myself. Go, see the Sect Master. You've earned your cake.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A nascent soul at your age. The elders are furious with envy. It's wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo told me about the design. He is checking it himself. If anyone can find a hidden flaw, it is him.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest, {player}. For the first time in months, I think the sect can breathe.

quests.title: The Great Azure Formation
quests.summary: The Great Azure Formation is nearly complete. Elder Mo has been checking its runes for three nights without sleep.

objectives.text: Watch Elder Mo inspect the Great Azure Formation
Inspect the Great Azure Formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ten thousand runes glow a calm blue. Only in the outer ring, one branch seems to twist, like a signature written backwards.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Three nights, ten thousand runes. My eyes feel like two boiled dumplings. Don't tell Wei Tong I said that.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I found something. A turn in the outer ring that shouldn't be there. I need one more night to be certain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Here. My old sword tassel. My master gave it to me when I formed my core. It's yours now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder, why give it to me now?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Because I'm old, and I forget things. Better to give it too early than too late. Go on, {junior}.

objectives.text: Spend an evening with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're back! You're taller. Are you taller? Nascent Soul makes people taller, I read it somewhere. Maybe.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo's been in a strange mood. Keeps patting my shoulder. He gave me his tea set. His good tea set.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old men do that before long journeys. He's not going anywhere, is he?

quests.title: A Letter from the Abyss
quests.summary: A crow has brought a letter to the sect gate, addressed to you, in the traitor's hand.

objectives.text: Collect the letter from Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A crow brought this. A crow! It bit me. Twice. It had opinions.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: It's addressed to you. The seal is the Law Hall's. I thought about burning it. Then I thought, you'd want to know.

objectives.text: Break the Law Hall seal on the letter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Come to the Heart Mirror, alone. I will tell you how to save your sect. Bring anyone, and I will tell you nothing. Gu Hanshan.

objectives.text: Show the letter to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's a trap. Obviously. Everything Gu does is a trap wrapped in a lesson.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: But if he knows something about the formation... Elder Mo found a flaw. I can't ignore this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I know. That's what worries me. Go. If you're not back by dawn, I'm telling Elder Mo, and then I'm coming to drag you home.

quests.title: The Mirror Pool
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan waits in the depths of the Blood Moon Abyss, alone and unarmed.

objectives.text: Slip past the scavengers on the field of bones
Hear the traitor out in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You came alone. Good. Then listen, because there is no time. The formation your sect built is a key, not a lock.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Twenty years ago I altered the archive copy. Seven runes. When it is lit, it will pour the sect's qi into the Abyss and break the seal from above.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I did it for Lan. The Patriarch swore he held her soul. He did. He fed it to the Heart Mirror long ago. I heard her screaming there.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I cannot face the mirror. It shows me what I am. You can. Free her. Then run home before they light it.

objectives.text: Approach the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pool of black water, perfectly still. Your reflection looks back at you. Then it smiles, a moment before you do.

quests.title: The Heart Demon
quests.summary: The mirror has let something out. It wears your face and knows all your fears.

objectives.text: Face the reflection in the Heart Mirror
Defeat your heart demon

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: You were never chosen, {player}. You were only unlucky enough to be born holding the key.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Everyone you love will die because of that pendant. Mo. Han Xue. That silly girl by the pond. Give it to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're not me. You're only the part of me that's afraid.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Then why are your hands shaking?

objectives.text: Still the mirror and free the trapped souls

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit at the water's edge. Your hands stop shaking. The mirror ripples, and light rises from it like fireflies.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hundreds of souls, drifting upward. One stops in front of you: a girl with Gu's eyes, who bows once, and is gone.

objectives.text: Return to Gu Hanshan

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I saw her. She bowed to you. She always had better manners than her father.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Go. Now. The formation... I can feel it waking even from here. Run, {player}, run!

quests.title: Burning Sky over Azure Cloud
quests.summary: The sky above the sect has turned red. The Great Azure Formation has been lit.

objectives.text: Race back to the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}! The formation lit itself at midnight. Blood Moon disciples came out of nowhere, in our robes!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Elder Mo went into the array. He told everyone to stay back. The light's gone red. It's gone all red!

objectives.text: Cut through the infiltrators at the gate
Clear the demonic cultivators guarding the array

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're protecting the array! They want it to keep burning. {player}, get to Elder Mo!

quests.title: Elder Mo's Choice
quests.summary: At the heart of the burning formation, Elder Mo makes his last decision.

objectives.text: Witness Elder Mo's last stand
Stand with the Sect Master at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He poured his whole life into the array's eye and turned the flow back. Seventy years of cultivation, in one breath.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The seal holds. The sect lives. And Mo Changfeng is gone.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He asked me to tell you something. He said, adequate. More than adequate.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He gave me his tea set. I thought he was being nice. He was saying goodbye, and I didn't even notice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I was going to make him dumplings. Proper ones, for his birthday. I've been practising for a month.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Make them anyway, Senior Brother. We'll eat them for him.

quests.title: Ashes and Incense
quests.summary: The sect mourns Elder Mo Changfeng.

objectives.text: Toll the great bell nine times

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine strokes. Across the mountain, every disciple stops what they are doing and bows toward the hall.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I've mended a thousand broken bones for that stubborn old man. He never once said thank you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: He'd leave peaches on my doorstep instead. Every autumn, for forty years. I'll miss the peaches.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I brought plum blossoms. Elder Mo pretended he didn't like flowers, but he always smelled them when he thought no one was looking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Are you all right? You don't have to be. My brother says being all right is overrated.

objectives.text: Remember Elder Mo at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sea of clouds, where you first condensed your qi. Elder Mo's tassel flutters in your hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Back straight. A crooked spine makes a crooked meridian. You straighten your back, and weep, and breathe.

quests.title: What the Patriarch Wants
quests.summary: With the altered formation in pieces, Elder Bai can finally read what it was meant to do.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai's findings

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I've read the seven altered runes. The formation would open the Abyss upward, like a stairwell, for one soul to climb.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Patriarch cannot survive the heavenly tribulation in his own body. Too much blood, too much sin. Heaven would erase him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He needs a body with a clean dao and the Verdant Lotus in its veins. The mirror was meant to crack your heart so he could step in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He wants to wear me. To ascend in my skin.

objectives.text: Compare the altered runes with the Heart Sutra

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Laid beside the Heart Sutra, the seven altered runes are plain as day: a lotus drawn upside down, a door drawn inside out.

objectives.text: Face Gu Hanshan in chains at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I surrendered at your gate an hour after you left the mirror. The Sect Master says my fate is yours to decide.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Execute me. It's what the precepts demand. I wrote half of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. Come with us to the Abyss. Fight as an elder of the Azure Cloud. If you must die, die as one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...Mo would have said the same. Very well. I will show you the way through the black gate.

quests.title: The Five Oaths
quests.summary: Before the final assault, gather your allies and hear their oaths.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang's oath

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan sent me a letter telling me to come home where it's safe. I used it to light incense for Elder Mo.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I swear on my brother's name, I'll be at your side at the black gate. Try not to steal all the glory.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Shi's oath

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I can't fight like you. But I know the Abyss. I was there for weeks. I'll draw every path I remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Man Man is making medicine bundles. Hundreds of them. She's only dropped a few.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian's oath

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is open. All of it. Take whatever you need. Spirit stones are useless to the dead.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I have counted every stone in this sect for thirty years. Tonight I will count nothing. Just come back.

objectives.text: Collect Xiao Man's medicine bundles for the army
Meet Ye Wuming at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The blood moon rises in three days. On that night the Patriarch will break free with or without your formation.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The children you let me take are with me. And Iron-Fang, with his men. We will open the way.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I owe you a name, {player}. I intend to pay.

quests.title: Soul Transformation
quests.summary: The Great Azure Formation has been repaired, its seven runes turned true. Use its power to transform your soul.

objectives.text: Set spirit stones into the repaired formation
Transform your soul at the heart of the formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where Elder Mo gave his life, you sit. The formation rises around you, blue and clean. It feels like being held.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul grows, merges with your body, and the boundary between you and heaven and earth thins like mist.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Mo. I'll carry it from here.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's blessing

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Soul Transformation. Heaven itself will notice you now. So will the Patriarch.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In three days we march on the Abyss, every disciple who can hold a sword. We end this, as our founders could not.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo believed in you before any of us. Let's prove him right, {player}.

quests.title: The Last Blood Moon
quests.summary: The Azure Cloud Sect marches on the Blood Moon Abyss.

objectives.text: Watch the Azure Cloud Sect gather at the Abyss
Receive the battle plan from the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wei Tong and Zhao Kang break the war camp. Ye Wuming's people take the obelisk ring. Gu will open the black gate.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You go through the gate, to the throne. I'll be behind you, holding the sect together.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Whatever happens, {player}, you are not carrying this alone. Remember the letter in the reliquary.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang at the canyon rim

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men are ready. Forty bandits, washed and fed, which is a first. They're a bit confused about it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Their families are behind that gate. We'll follow you through anything, sect brat. Sorry. Sect hero.

objectives.text: Stand with Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay alive. That's not a request, it's what the Sect Master said, and I'm saying it louder.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And after, when this is done, you owe me a proper sparring match. No holding back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: After, Senior Sister. I promise.

quests.title: Breaking the Line
quests.summary: The Blood Moon army holds the field of bones and the war camp. Break through.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guard line on the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: For Elder Mo! Hey, Elder, are you watching? Watch this one!

objectives.text: Burn the Blood Moon war camp

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Left side's mine, {player}! You can have the right side. It's smaller.

objectives.text: Regroup with Wei Tong at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We did it! The camp's burning, and I've only lost one bun. It was a very brave bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go on. The gate's ahead. Elder Mo would've said something grumpy and encouraging. Pretend I did.

quests.title: The Black Gate
quests.summary: The fortress gate can only be opened from inside. Gu Hanshan has a way in.

objectives.text: Meet Gu Hanshan at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Remember the blood-red token you took from Iron-Fang's chest? The one I confiscated? I kept it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: It's a command token. With it, the gate guards will let me in. They don't know yet what I have become.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They'll kill you when they find out.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. I've made my peace with that. It is the first peace I have felt in twenty years.

objectives.text: Wait before the black gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gate is black iron, carved with a moon swallowing a sword. It is taller than the main hall. It is utterly silent.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then, from inside, the sound of fighting. One man against many.

objectives.text: Break the gate's last seal

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the seal with the Lotus Key. From the other side, someone pulls the great bar. The black gate groans open.

quests.title: Court of Crimson
quests.summary: Fight through the fortress courtyard, and find the man who opened the gate.

objectives.text: Clear the fortress courtyard
Kneel beside Gu Hanshan at the gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Ah. You came. I held them... as long as I could. I was always better at law than fighting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tell the sect... tell them the Law Hall is empty now. Fill it with someone kinder than me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Lan... is waiting. I think she'll let me apologise. Thank you, {player}.

objectives.text: Break open the last cages

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last locks fall. Mothers, children, old men stumble into the red light, blinking, alive.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the cages

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They're here. All of them. My sister. My men's wives, their children. Alive.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Today, in full. My blade is yours until the Patriarch's head is on the floor.

quests.title: Void Refinement
quests.summary: The Altar of Blood still feeds the Patriarch. Destroy it, and let the void teach you what remains.

objectives.text: Defeat the altar's last defenders
Shatter the Altar of Blood

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The altar cracks from top to bottom. Three hundred years of stolen blood pours out and soaks away into the stone.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's done. His power has no root now. Only what he carries in himself.

objectives.text: Refine your soul in the void

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the silence after the altar breaks, you sink inward. Past body, past qi, past soul, to the empty place beneath.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing is there. And nothing is exactly enough. You rise with the stillness of the void in your bones.

quests.title: The Blood Moon Patriarch
quests.summary: Xue Wuji waits on his throne, and he has been waiting for three hundred years.

objectives.text: Cut down the Patriarch's throne guards
Confront the Blood Moon Patriarch
Defeat the Blood Moon Patriarch

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: Come then, little lotus. Show me the body I will wear to heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My body stays mine, Xue Wuji. So does my heart.

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: We shall see how long you hold them both.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: His body is dust. But his remnant soul tore free and fled upward. To the Sky Isles.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Your breakthrough has drawn heaven's eye. Your tribulation is gathering. He means to steal it, and ascend in your place.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I have my name back, {player}. The children have theirs. Go. Finish it. We'll hold the abyss.

quests.title: Pursuit to the Heavens
quests.summary: The Patriarch's remnant has fled to the Sky Isles. Follow it before the tribulation begins.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You're back early. Also, the sky is on fire. I assume those two facts are related.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A remnant soul crossed my bridge an hour ago. It is climbing toward the tribulation peak, possessing everything it touches.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Heaven's lightning is gathering for you, lotus child. Get to the peak before he does.

objectives.text: Fight through the possessed Blood Guards on the jade bridge
Speak with Han Xue on the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I followed you through the array. Obviously. Did you think I'd let you face the sky alone?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'll hold the bridge. Nothing else crosses. Go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}... you still owe me that sparring match. Don't you dare ascend without paying your debts.

quests.title: Remnants of the Blood Moon
quests.summary: The remnant has corrupted the immortal garden. Clear the way and prepare lightning rods of thunder crystal.

objectives.text: Purge the possessed cultivators in the garden
Gather thunder crystals to ground the tribulation
Charge the crystals at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystals drink from the vein until they hum. Planted on the summit, they will split heaven's lightning like a river delta.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look at me like that. Of course I came. Someone has to witness your triumph and complain about it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Swear something to me. When you come back down, we fight. Properly. And I win.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When I come back down, Zhao Kang. And you'll lose.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha! That's the spirit. Go. The sky is waiting, and it has terrible manners.

quests.title: Heavenly Tribulation
quests.summary: The heavenly tribulation descends on the summit, and the Patriarch's remnant rides the lightning.

objectives.text: Ascend to the tribulation peak
Survive the heart tribulation and destroy the remnant

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: The ninth bolt is the heart tribulation. I will be your heart, little lotus.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Hello again, {player}. He found me in the mirror. He says we can share.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I beat you once. I'll do it as often as it takes.

objectives.text: Endure the nine bolts of heavenly lightning

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lightning comes. First, second, third. Your body breaks and remakes itself. Fourth, fifth, sixth. Your qi burns white.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seventh, eighth. The remnant screams as the lightning finds it, and there is nothing left of Xue Wuji but ash on the wind.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ninth bolt strikes, and it does not hurt at all. It feels like the sky, saying your name.

quests.title: Immortal Ascension
quests.summary: The Ascension Stair has opened. Say your farewells, and climb.

objectives.text: Say farewell to the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The stair has opened for you. Three hundred years, and our sect has its first immortal.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You don't have to go. The heavens will wait. They have nothing but time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If I stay, the stair closes, and nobody climbs it again for a thousand years. Someone should see what's up there.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Then go, {player}. And look down on us sometimes. We'll be the ones waving.

objectives.text: Say farewell to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sixty years I waited here for someone worth the climb. It was worth it. Don't tell anyone I said so.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: At the top, you'll find a door. Knock politely. Heaven is very sensitive about manners.

objectives.text: Climb the Ascension Stair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Each step is made of light. Below, your friends grow small. Han Xue raises her sword in salute. Zhao Kang pretends not to cry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Mo. Mother. Everyone. Thank you.

objectives.text: Ascend
Epilogue: the Azure Cloud Sect

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Three hundred years ago, the Azure Cloud and the Verdant Lotus sealed a monster beneath the earth, and the world forgot.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Only the Azure Cloud Sect remembers. It keeps its watch on this mountain, above the sea of clouds.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Every spring, its gate opens to those with the talent and stubbornness to climb nine thousand steps.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: This spring, an orphan with nothing but a jade pendant reached the top.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: The Azure Cloud Sect. I made it, Mother.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The teleport array flares, and the mountain is gone. In its place, bamboo, green and endless, whispering in the wind.

shots.speaker: senior_wei
shots.text: First mission outside the walls! Don't wander off, don't eat red mushrooms, and don't pet anything with more than four eyes.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Whispering Bamboo Forest. Spirit herbs grow here, and spirit wolves hunt here. Usually they leave cultivators alone.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Usually.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Qingshi Town. Rice fields, a river, a market, and a temple where the kindly keeper buries the dead.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Every new moon, somebody vanishes. Every morning after, the town pretends not to notice.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Almost everybody.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Visitors from the mountain! How wonderful. May the ancestors bless your journey, young immortals.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: Eyes open, {junior}. Towns that smile this hard are usually hiding something.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Clever children. Too clever. Keeper Hong was such a comfortable face. I wore it for eleven years.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The old man's skin splits like a husk. Beneath it: black and crimson robes, and eyes the colour of blood.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Deacon Hong Lie of the Blood Moon. The Patriarch stirs, lotus-bearer, and he dreams of you.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: Acolytes in the alley! {player}, he's running for the graves!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: North of the wolf dens, where even the bamboo grows quiet, the forest hides something older than any sect alive.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Verdant Lotus Sect. Once it stood beside the Azure Cloud as an equal. Now its name is a footnote.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Its ruins keep their secrets well. But stones cannot be cut out of a book.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: So. The lotus comes home at last. I had hoped to be dead before it did.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Three hundred years ago the Blood Moon Patriarch drowned three kingdoms in blood, reaching for the heavens.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Our sect master and your founder bound him beneath the Abyss. The seal needed two keys, and a price.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: The Verdant Lotus paid it. Every elder gave their life to the seal. The Patriarch's servants hunted the rest of us.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: One disciple fled with the Lotus Key and a baby girl. Her line hid among mortals for three centuries.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Your mother's pendant, child, is that key. And you are the last of the Verdant Lotus.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once every three years, the Azure Cloud Sect raises its banners for the Inner Sect Tournament.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Disciples of the Azure Cloud! Fight hard, fight fair, and whoever breaks the formation tiles pays for them.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: The victor will stand beside me and learn the secrets of the Azure Eye. Show heaven what this sect is made of.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: In the crowd, not everyone is watching the fighters.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Nine to one odds. Lu Ping had better not be wrong about me.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The pagoda doors hang open. Scrolls lie scattered like fallen leaves. And at the heart of the mess stands the Law Hall Elder.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: You were supposed to be watching the final, disciple. Everyone was supposed to be watching the final.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Elder Gu. The token, the missions, the pages, the pills. It was you. All of it.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: I did what a father does. Heaven took my daughter. The Blood Moon offered her back. You would have done the same.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Gu Hanshan! Put down the diagram and kneel, or I will strike you down where you stand.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: Forty years of loyalty, Sect Master, and you never once asked why I stopped smiling. Kill them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Blood Moon Abyss. A wound in the earth, three hundred years deep, where the moon is always red.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once a kingdom stood here. Its people were the Patriarch's first harvest.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: It stinks of old blood. Stay behind me. No. Stay beside me. Where I can see you.

shots.speaker: wanderer_ye
shots.text: Step where I step. Breathe when I breathe. Welcome to the place I was born.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Blood from the broken obelisks still trickles along the channels, up the dais, into the great altar.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: The diagram is delivered, Patriarch. The Azure Eye's design is in your hands. Now keep your promise. Give me my Lan.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: Patience, loyal Gu. When I walk again, you will have everything you deserve. Everything.

shots.speaker: crimson_xuemei
shots.text: Master, the lotus-bearer is here. The little lamb has come to the altar all by itself.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: Disciple. You should not have come. Xue Mei, keep it alive. The Patriarch needs the body intact.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Blood Moon comes to Qingshi on the third night: demon cultivators, blood-fed wolves, and Iron-Fang's bandits beside them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Their banners rise on the graveyard hill, above empty graves the town has only just refilled.

shots.speaker: rival_zhao
shots.text: I count four hundred. Maybe five. I'd count better if they stood still.

shots.speaker: magistrate_zhou
shots.text: People of Qingshi! Last time, we hid. We locked our doors and let a monster feed on our children. Not this time!

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Then we hold. Every street, every house, every wall. Not one more grave.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once every sixty years the clouds part, and the Celestial Sky Isles drift down within reach of mortal arrays.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Here, where immortals once lived, star iron falls like rain and thunder grows in the rocks like crystal flowers.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Everything is floating. The whole world is floating.

shots.speaker: rival_zhao
shots.text: Please stop saying floating. Say resting on very tall air.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And at the highest point, the summit where heavenly tribulation strikes, waits the stair that climbs to heaven.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation stands complete: star iron pillars, thunder crystals, a web of ten thousand runes.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Outer ring. Seventh branch. This rune turns outward. It should turn inward. Why would it turn outward?

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: The Law Hall archive. Thirty years of Gu's hands on every page. Oh, you fool. You poor, grieving fool.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Above the sea of clouds, the moon rises, and for the first time in three hundred years, it rises red.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The water does not ripple. Your reflection rises from it, dripping darkness, wearing your face like a mask.

shots.speaker: heart_demon
shots.text: Hello, {player}. Don't you recognise me? I'm every time you were afraid, and pretended you weren't.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: I know what you are. A heart demon. You feed on doubt.

shots.speaker: heart_demon
shots.text: Then I'll never go hungry. Let me in. I'll carry the key for you. Isn't it heavy? Isn't it so very heavy?

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation roars like a furnace, blood-red, pulling the mountain's qi downward into the dark.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Stay back, all of you! Seven runes. I can turn seven runes. I just need something big enough to push them.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Elder Mo, no! Let me help, I have the Lotus Key!

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: The key is for tomorrow, {junior}. Tonight is for old men. Back straight, now. Crooked spine, crooked meridian.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Elder Mo Changfeng burns his core, his soul and seventy years of cultivation in a single breath. The red light turns blue.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Mo Changfeng. Elder of the Outer Court. You stubborn, stubborn old man.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Under the last blood moon, the Azure Cloud Sect goes to war: elders, disciples, a bandit's army and a traitor in chains.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Three hundred years ago our founders stood here and did not finish the job. We will finish it.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: For Mo Changfeng. For the Verdant Lotus. For everyone this Abyss has swallowed. Azure Cloud, advance!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Beyond the black gate, on a throne of fused bone, something that was once a man opens its eyes.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Xue Wuji, Patriarch of the Blood Moon. Three kingdoms drowned for his ambition. Three centuries of hunger in the dark.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: The last of the Verdant Lotus. Do you know how long I have waited for you? Your great-grandmother's great-grandmother escaped me.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: You broke Gu with grief. You tried to break me with fear. It didn't work.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: Then I will break you the old way. With my hands. Come, little lotus. Show me my new body.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Above the summit, the clouds spiral into a black eye nine miles wide. Heaven has seen you. Heaven is coming.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Nine bolts. Elder Bai said nobody knows what the ninth one is. Wonderful.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: I know, little lotus. The ninth is the heart. And I will be waiting inside it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Ascension Stair opens, step by step, a road of light from the summit into the clouds.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Below, the Sect Master bows. Han Xue raises her sword. Zhao Kang shouts something rude, and wipes his eyes.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: I'll come back. Maybe not soon. But I'll come back.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And {player}, last of the Verdant Lotus, disciple of the Azure Cloud, climbs into the heavens.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation holds. The Blood Moon Abyss is sealed, and this time, the seal will last ten thousand years.

shots.speaker: senior_wei
shots.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! And whoever breaks the puppet buys lunch. For Elder Mo!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: An old hermit teaches the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra in the pagoda. Every morning, more students come.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Xiao Man grows herbs. She only drops some of them. Her brother writes every week.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And on clear nights, above the sea of clouds, one star blinks twice, as if someone up there were waving.
